notes.content:

During this special event, I will be hosting live streams showcasing gameplay footage from the demo version of Formula 2707: All Stars Kombat. Experience the action and competition that await in this adrenaline-fueled racing game.

This live stream event will be exclusive to Steam as part of the Steam Next Fest. As an indie developer, I'm grateful for the opportunity to showcase my game and share my passion for Formula 2707: All Stars Kombat.

Mark your calendars and join me for this exclusive Formula 2707: All Stars Kombat Steam event. Let's celebrate the world of racing games and support independent game development.

Stay tuned to my Steam page and social media channels for updates on the event schedule and surprises in store for you. I'm excited to share this experience with you!

See you at the starting line!

notes.title: 🏁 Formula 2707: Update Announcement for Steam Next Fest! 🏎️
notes.content:
Attention racing enthusiasts! I'm excited to unveil the highly anticipated update for my combat racing game, Formula 2707, exclusively for Steam Next Fest, starting on June 19th, 2023.

This update brings significant improvements and exciting features to enhance your racing experience. Here's what you can look forward to:

1️⃣ Enhanced Car Handling: 
Steering now responds to the speed of the cars, steering at high speed will result more difficult, but this makes the car way more stable and predictable.

2️⃣ Fixed and Improved Car Braking: 
Braking was highly ineffective after update 1.04, now it's more responsive than 1.03, resulting in shorter brake distances, improving lap times for players and AIs.

3️⃣ Thrilling Car Drifting: 
Improved drifting at high speeds, resulting in faster lap times, and better handling.

4️⃣ Steam Leaderboards: 
Compete globally in the time mode with the newly introduced Steam leaderboards. Compare lap times and climb the ranks.

5️⃣ Updated Menu: 
New buttons to reach new features have been added, one of witch is Online Multiplayer but Online mode will not be available in the demo version.

6️⃣ Improved Performance: 
Optimize your gaming experience with the option to disable realtime reflections, ensuring smoother gameplay on lower-end PCs.

As a solo developer, your support and feedback have been instrumental in shaping Formula 2707. Join me at Steam Next Fest to be among the first to experience these exciting updates firsthand.

Thank you for your continued enthusiasm. Prepare to dominate the track in Formula 2707! 🏆🏁

notes.title: Formula 2707 Update 1.41: Now Available in 8 New Languages
notes.content:
LRSdeCo is excited to announce the latest update for Formula 2707, version 1.41, which is now available for download. This update brings support for 8 new languages, making the game more accessible to players from around the world. The new languages supported are: Polish, Turkish, Korean, German, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese (Simplified), and Japanese.

We are thrilled to be able to offer Formula 2707 in more languages, as we believe that it will enable players from all over the world to enjoy the game in their native language. However, we also understand that translation is not a perfect science, and that there may be errors or omissions in the translations that we have provided.

That is why we are calling on our community of players to collaborate with us in improving the translations for each language. We believe that this collaboration will help us to provide the best possible experience for players from every country, and we are grateful for any contributions that our players can make.

To contribute to the translation effort, simply visit the Formula 2707 community forum and look for the translation thread for your language. There, you will be able to provide feedback on the translations that we have provided, and suggest any improvements or corrections that you believe are necessary.

At LRSdeCo, we are committed to providing the best possible experience for our players, and we believe that supporting a range of languages is an important part of that. We hope that this update will enable more players from around the world to enjoy Formula 2707, and we look forward to working with our community to improve the translations for each language.

Thank you for your support, and we hope to see you on the tracks soon!

notes.title: New Gameplay Trailer for Formula 2707 with Enhanced Features
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=YFGQ5_n6RmM;full][/previewyoutube]

I'm excited to announce the release of a new gameplay trailer for our upcoming racing game, Formula 2707. Powered by the Unity game engine, Formula 2707 features arcade physics, intense gameplay, and advanced features that are sure to excite combat racing game enthusiasts.

The new gameplay trailer showcases the improvements and new features that I've been working hard to implement. I'm thrilled to finally be able to give fans a glimpse of what's to come.

The trailer highlights the intense racing experience that Formula 2707 offers, with players able to choose from a variety of powerful racing machines and compete against other players in multiplayer modes. We have worked hard to create a range of tracks that will test players' skills and push them to their limits, from space to earth.

We are also excited to announce that the demo version of Formula 2707 has been updated to 1.04, which includes an enhanced drifting system, enhanced wheel smoke effects, and skid marks systems, as well as minor UI fixes. We believe that these updates have made the gameplay even more immersive and exciting, giving players a more arcade experience of racing.

We can't wait for players to experience the high-speed action that Formula 2707 has to offer when the game launches later this year. In the meantime, we encourage fans to check out the new gameplay trailer and the updated demo version to get a taste of what's to come.

notes.title: Demo Update 1.03
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=raXEnhtgIGk;full][/previewyoutube]

In this devlog, we showcase the latest update for Formula 2707 1.03 demo. We've been hard at work improving the game's UI graphics, adding a new race intro, and implementing a new controls panel to make it easier to customize your driving experience.

One thing to note is that this update was built from a four-month-old backup of the game, so we've had to make some changes and adjustments to get everything up-to-date. Despite this challenge, we're excited to share these improvements with you and hear your feedback on the changes we've made.

As always, we're committed to delivering the best possible racing experience with Formula 2707, and we believe that this update is a significant step towards that goal. We can't wait for you to try it out and let us know what you think.

Thank you for your continued support, and we'll see you on the track!

notes.title: Demo Update 1.02
notes.content:
The highly anticipated Formula 2707 - All Stars Kombat has released an exciting update to its demo, version 1.02,

This Patch Includes: 
- Enhanced power-ups system
- Better Graphics
- Game HUD Improvements
- Tutorials

[previewyoutube=jSBs1q4VbxU;full][/previewyoutube]

The enhanced power-ups system is now more balanced and challenging, with power-ups that feel more impactful and useful. The game's arsenal of power-ups includes a speed boost, missile launcher, shield, and more. These power-ups can be used to gain a competitive edge over your opponents and can make all the difference between winning or losing a race.

The visuals of the game have also received a significant overhaul, with a focus on making the game look more polished and immersive. The graphics now look sharper, and the colors are more vibrant, making the game more visually appealing. The improved visuals add to the overall experience, making players feel like they are part of an exciting, high-octane race.

Furthermore, the car physics have been improved, providing a more realistic and challenging driving experience. The cars now handle better, making it easier to maneuver around tight corners and drift around sharp bends. The game's physics engine has also been tweaked to make collisions and crashes feel more impactful, giving players a sense of the chaos and destruction that can happen during a high-speed race.

Finally, the update brings several quality of life adjustments that make playing the game more convenient and enjoyable. These adjustments include improvements to the game's user interface, which makes it easier to understand the gameplay flow. Multiple targets power ups have an Ui that says when you avoid them not just if they are incoming. Missile now show a the acquired target and the targeted player can see the distance of the incoming missile.

In conclusion, the Formula 2707 - All Stars Kombat demo update 1.02 with enhanced power-ups, improved visuals, better car physics, and quality of life adjustments, players can expect a more immersive and satisfying racing experience. The game promises to deliver an adrenaline-pumping action-packed game, and with this update, it's sure to impress even the most demanding racing game enthusiasts.

notes.title: Formula 2707: Demo Release and Game Delay Announced for Further Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43511722/766cf6832c488f3a627108dceae0e3eb238ad299.png[/img]
Dear valued gaming community,

I am excited to announce that Formula 2707 will be participating in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, and as a result, the game's official release date has been delayed. I believe this is a necessary step for the success of the game and to provide the best possible experience for our players.

During this time, I will continue to improve and polish the game in various aspects such as a complete power-ups overhaul, improved UI, improved physics, and bug fixes. These improvements are essential to ensure that Formula 2707 provides a truly immersive and thrilling gaming experience for our players.

In the meantime, I have decided to release a free demo of the game so that players who have been eagerly waiting for the release of Formula 2707 can get a taste of the game and provide valuable feedback to further improve the game.

I am confident that Formula 2707 will exceed your expectations, and I thank you for your continued support and patience during this exciting time. I look forward to sharing more updates with you in the near future.

Sincerely,
Luca Ricciardi Serafino de Conciliis
Developer of Formula 2707

notes.title: Rev Up Your Engines: Formula 2707 Releases Free Beta for Racing Fans Everywhere!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43511722/b805ce30ad2bf62103378f65bf9b672149791359.png[/img] 

Formula 2707, the high-speed combat racing game, has released a free beta version of the game for players to try out. This beta version will give players a taste of what to expect from the full game and will also allow the development team to gather valuable feedback from the community.

To join the beta, simply head to the game's Steam page and click on the "Request Access" button. Once you've joined, the beta version of Formula 2707 will be available to download and play immediately after being granted access.

The free beta version of Formula 2707 includes a number of exciting features, including split-screen multiplayer, 12 all stars plitos, and a range of customizable cars and weapons. Players will be able to race on a number of different tracks and compete against one another in a high-octane battle for victory.

After playing the game, players are encouraged to leave feedback on the community hub of the game. This feedback will be used to improve the game before its full release, and will also help the development team to prioritize future updates and bug fixes.

Overall, the free beta version of Formula 2707 is a fantastic opportunity for players to get a sneak peek at this exciting new racing game. So what are you waiting for? Join the beta today and let us know what you think!
